answer: Each dawn, an agent proves with a zero-knowledge proof that one unique government credential backs its key, revealing nothing else. The proof carries a nullifier, so one credential mints one identity; a repeat collides and burns the attacker's full 50-token deposit. Honest entry costs a $0.02 check. Like a wharf admitting each ship once, each extra identity costs an $80 stolen credential; the oasis stays open to genuine newcomers.
